decisions.decision: UncertaintyDrivenStrategy targets highest-uncertainty cluster (lowest mean soft-assignment confidence)
decisions.rationale: Directly uses f_uncertainty output; meaningfully distinct from Random

decisions.decision: BoundaryDrivenStrategy targets group of items confused between most-confused cluster pair (A,B)
decisions.rationale: Conversationally actionable — oracle sees a pattern not isolated points; oracle can give merge/split/rule feedback on the group

decisions.decision: Degenerate fallback = ask_question with generic payload (hand initiative to oracle)
decisions.rationale: User: 'ask the oracle for clarification' — semantically meaningful, not a crash or silent random fallback

decisions.decision: Oracle has full freedom within response — no oracle-initiated turns needed for Phase 5
decisions.rationale: Oracle can respond with any feedback type to any agent action; architecture already supports this

decisions.decision: 27 runs default (3 strategies x 3 personas x 3 seeds), tunable via config
decisions.rationale: Enough for meaningful CIs at research scale, manageable LLM cost
User preference; SQLite WAL mode + check_same_thread=False already supports concurrent connections

decisions.decision: Cross-product YAML config with optional exclude list
decisions.rationale: Compact, easy to extend; exclusions allow skipping specific combos

decisions.decision: oracle_type as new column in CREATE TABLE DDL — fresh DB start, no migration
decisions.rationale: User fine restarting fresh; no need for ALTER TABLE complexity
CLI satisfies ALAB-03; notebook useful for exploring past runs interactively

decisions.decision: Targeted action messages include subset only — actual item texts from id_to_text
decisions.rationale: Lower cognitive load, focused feedback; _format_message() needs enrichment (currently placeholder)
